question: Find the value of [(14 times 9) timesleft{8 div 2 times ((18-15))/(3)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

Expression to solve = [(14 × 9) ×left{8 div 2 × ((18-15))/(3)right}] 

**Formula Used:**

Follow BODMAS (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction).

**Calculation:**

[(14 × 9) ×left{8 div 2 × ((18-15))/(3)right}] 

⇒ [(126) ×left{4 × (3)/(3)right}] 

⇒ 126 × 4

⇒ 504

**The value of the expression is 504.**
